report: Facebook is the top priority, with a 34.65 estimated enrollment gap, 60.62% of leads but only 12.50% of enrollments, and L2W as its weakest stage at 18.95%; LinkedIn follows with a 3.26 gap and A2E weakest at 57.14%. Google is the strongest scaled source, generating 27.78% of enrollments from 12.47% of leads with 3.48% L2E, while low-volume Others generated 16.67% of enrollments from 2.95% of leads. These benchmark gaps are counterfactual prioritization estimates—not demonstrated causes or guaranteed recoverable enrollments—and cost comparisons are limited because spend is available for only 3 of 8 sources (37.5%), with missing spend not assumed to be zero.
